name: Avenue 50 Studio
about_text: Avenue 50 Studio is a nonprofit arts presentation organization in the Highland Park neighborhood of Northeast Los Angeles. Founded in 2000 by Kathy Gallegos, who continues to serve as its Founding Executive and Artistic Director, the space describes its mission as bridging cultures through content-driven visual art grounded in Latina/o culture and the Northeast LA community. The program mixes exhibitions of emerging and established artists with literary programming, including a long-running poetry series, workshops, and community projects such as mural restoration. Governed by a volunteer board of directors alongside its staff, the studio positions itself as a destination gallery for socially engaged, culturally rooted contemporary art.

triage.site_notes: This nonprofit gallery organizes content primarily by exhibition year archives (numerous /20XX-archive and /20XX-2 pages spanning 2003-2026) rather than a single artist roster; hundreds of individual exhibition/event/workshop pages exist but are superseded by these yearly archive indexes, so they were left as 'other'. About/mission/board/funders and contact/hours pages are clearly identifiable; no dedicated news or fairs pages were found.
